Deze international is gespecialiseerd in de productie en de toelevering van kunststofonderdelen voor de automobielindustrie; spuitgietonderdelen voor voertuigen.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Do you have experience working with fabrics and know how to identify different pattern pieces? For a garment manufacturing company in the Tielt region, we are looking for someone to prepare fabrics for the cutting process and correctly sort the cut pattern pieces.

• You set up the machine and monitor the automatic unrolling and layering of the fabric.

• You take into account the fabric direction, warp and weft when preparing the materials

• You identify weaving defects and other irregularities and position the fabric in such a way that defective sections do not end up in the finished garments

• You check that the fabrics are correctly prepared and ready for the cutting machine.

• You collect the cut pieces and sort them according to the correct pattern.

• You group components such as sleeves, collars, front panels and back panels so they can be processed together in the next production stage.

• You follow the production schedule and ensure that the work progresses smoothly and efficiently.

 

• You have knowledge of fabrics and textiles, preferably gained through experience in a garment workshop or textile company.

• You can identify different garment components and pattern pieces.

• You can recognise fabric defects and know how to take them into account when laying out the fabric.

• You work accurately while maintaining a good production pace.

• You can count correctly and distinguish between colours, sizes and quantities.

• You have a sufficient understanding of Dutch to correctly interpret work instructions, numbers and labels. Knowledge of English is also an advantage.

• You are physically fit for the job and can work both independently and as part of a team.

• Sewing skills are not required. However, it is important that you can recognise fabrics and the different components of a garment.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Job Description

As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

• Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.

• Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.

• Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.

• Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.

• Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.

• Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!

• You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.

• You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!

• You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.

• As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)

• You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

My client is looking for a Business Consultant POS Systems to support and improve the technology behind 400  Point-of-Sale terminals across 40 stores in Belgium and the Netherlands. This role is central to ensuring seamless store operations while contributing to major transformation projects in an evolving omnichannel retail environment.

Jobomschrijving

As part of a close-knit international team, you will act as the link between business stakeholders, IT teams and external vendors. You will ensure the stability and evolution of the POS landscape while helping prepare the organisation for future challenges, including the replacement of its current POS platform.

• Ensure the availability and performance of POS systems across all stores.
• Manage incidents and provide second and third-line support.
• Gather business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
• Coordinate with software vendors and implementation partners.
• Support the rollout of new functionalities such as self-checkout, self-scan and advanced pricing and promotional features.
• Contribute to projects focused on modernising store operations and enhancing the customer experience.
• Work closely with SAP teams to ensure seamless integration between retail systems.
• Support omnichannel initiatives and the growing importance of eCommerce within the organisation.
• Play an active role in the future replacement of the current POS solution.

You understand retail operations and enjoy working in a business-facing IT role where you can combine analysis, process improvement and technology. You may come from a background such as: Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Application Manager, Retail System Specialist, POS Consultant, Store Operation IT Specialist.

• Dutch is mandatory, Professional level of English, French is a strong plus.
• Experience in a retail environment.
• Understanding of store operations and retail business processes.
• Experience with POS systems is highly desirable.
• Ability to translate business needs into effective IT solutions.
• Experience working with vendors and multiple stakeholders.
• SAP knowledge is considered an advantage.

For a leading American multinational company in the consumer products industry, recognized worldwide for its innovation and commitment to quality, we are currently looking for a Lab Associate to strengthen the team. This is a unique opportunity to work in a high-tech environment where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are at the forefront. Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and eager to work in a modern laboratory setting? Then this position may be the perfect fit for you. In this role: 

 
• you will be responsible for a variety of laboratory activities carried out in accordance with established procedures 
 
•  
 You will organize, set up, and perform stability testing using a range of laboratory instruments, including pH meters, viscometers, colorimeters, ovens, incubators, and climate chambers. 

 
•  
 You will test the enzymatic activity of finished products using a spectrophotometer, following standard operating procedures. 

 
•  
 You will collect various samples, including water samples, swabs, ambient plates, and raw materials, ensuring proper sampling techniques are applied. 

 
• You will be responsible for sampling incoming materials and preparing them for laboratory analysis. 
 
• You will plan and perform FTIR testing when required, maintaining a high level of accuracy throughout the process. 
 
• You will ensure accurate administration and data management by entering and maintaining laboratory data in the relevant systems. 
 
•  
 You will act as a communication link between departments and suppliers, proactively helping to resolve issues when they arise.

 
• You hold at least an A2 diploma in Science/Chemistry or have relevant laboratory experience. 
 
• You have a good command of English, both written and spoken (mandatory). 
 
• You are familiar with Microsoft Office applications and can use them confidently and efficiently.

Flint Group Digital Xeikon

 Lier, Belgium

Lead industrial inkjet development from business case to market introduction, bringing multidisciplinary teams together to turn customer needs into production-ready printing solutions.
 

About Flint Group Digital Xeikon and the role
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon, part of Flint Group, develops digital printing solutions for labels and packaging. As R&D Project Manager, you will lead projects across our inkjet portfolio, including Panther UV inkjet label presses and IDERA aqueous inkjet solutions for corrugated applications.
 

Reporting to the Director Inkjet & Program Management, you will guide development, validation, industrialisation and launch, leading cross-functional teams through collaboration and influence.
 

What you will do
 

--> see attachement

• 
 A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, applied science or technology, or equivalent relevant experience.
 

• 
 At least five years of project management experience in complex industrial product development, including work with external suppliers or development partners.
 

• 
 Strong planning, budget and risk management skills, with experience of validation, industrialisation and structured project reviews.
 

• 
 The technical judgement to work across disciplines, communicate clearly and align stakeholders without formal authority.
 

•

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms. 

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration. 

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.
